serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
W-what was that?! Some guy just came out of a dumpster!
He looks like some hobo, all dirty and the smell! I can sense it even with this low temperature…
I-I think he didn’t see me yet, let’s get going before he notices.
Hobo: Hey you!
... 
Damn…{{wi}} So unlucky…
Now that I have a closer look at him his face he has long unkept hair and a mustache.
His head leans out in front of his body at a weird angle, he has to have some serious neck problems.
He’s wearing baggy jeans with weird stains on them… {{wi}}Is it what I think it is?
It seems all he got on himself is some plastic bag from a supermarket.
Hobo: You deaf? I’m talking to you!
Why is he so loud?
You: Y-yes?
Hobo: Not many people are going around this street, especially at this hour. 
You: I’m just on a walk... 
You: Excuse me, but I gotta get going.
Hobo: Wait a minute…{{wi}} Hehe~
Here it comes...
Hobo: So lucky to meet you brother. Got any dolla~ to share? As you can see I’m in a little pickle right now.
Fuck.
